scope: PR375/PR124 grid restoration after a visibility toggle, without pointer motion
user_report: After turning the grid off, turning it on does not display it until the mouse moves.
cause: The default gizmo group lost its asset when an empty solid viewport hid the grid. Restoring the grid allocated an asset that was absent from the completed idle render; subsequent pointer-driven scene work made it visible.
fix: Retain the default gizmo asset with the existing transparent zero-length sentinel used by other transient line groups. Restoring the grid reuses its uploaded asset; no added scene requests or rendering loops.
